arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse
import pickle

print('=== R1: letters format specifier ===')
p = parse.Parser('{name:l}')
result = p.search('hello world')
print(f'  {{name:l}} on \"hello\": {result}')
if result:
    print(f'  Value: {result[\"name\"]}')
# Should not match numbers
result2 = p.search('hello123')
print(f'  {{name:l}} on \"hello123\": {result2}')

print()
print('=== R2: __contains__ method ===')
r = parse.parse('{a} {b}', 'hello world')
print(f'  Result: {r}')
print(f'  \"hello\" in r: {\"hello\" in r}')
print(f'  \"xyz\" in r: {\"xyz\" in r}')

print()
print('=== R3: Brace validation ===')
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{name')
    print('  ERROR: should have raised ValueError')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'  Unmatched opening brace: OK ({e})')

try:
    p = parse.Parser('{name}}')
    print('  ERROR: should have raised ValueError')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'  Unmatched closing brace: OK ({e})')

# Escaped braces should be OK
p = parse.Parser('{{escaped}}')
print(f'  Escaped braces work: OK')

print()
print('=== R4: FixedTzOffset timezone parsing ===')
# This is tested internally via date types
" 2>/dev/null
